findings.evidence: Species.lean:240-242; the conclusion quantifies over no `Q2` beyond the argument, so the `∀ Q2` content of `h` is unused.
findings.fix: Weaken to the per-scale hypothesis: `theorem valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_eq {f} {i} {Q2 : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f (.quark i) x Q2 = f (.antiquark i) x Q2) : valenceNumber f i Q2 = 0`, proved by `simp [valenceNumber_def, mellinMoment, h]`. The charge-conjugation-invariant use case still supplies it.
findings.issue: `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_eq` takes `h : f (.quark i) = f (.antiquark i)`, equality of the full functions of `x` and `Q2`, while the conclusion is about a single `Q2`. The proof only uses `h` at that scale (`rw [valenceNumber_def, mellinMoment, mellinMoment, h, sub_self]` rewrites inside one integrand), and roadmap Convention 5 (README.md:149-153) makes per-scale statements the norm.

findings.evidence: Compare Basic.lean:196-200 with Species.lean:209-213 field for field; Species.lean:191-200 show the derived pattern used elsewhere in the same file.
findings.fix: `def SumRuleAssumptions.chargeConj ... := h.relabel conj_involutive.bijective` and `theorem Assumptions.chargeConj ... := h.relabel conj` (both typecheck by defeq since `chargeConj f` unfolds to `relabel conj f`); `chargeConj_valenceTarget` stays `rfl`. Adding a general `relabel_relabel` (`relabel σ (relabel τ f) = relabel (τ ∘ σ) f`) would likewise let `chargeConj_chargeConj` derive from `conj_involutive` instead of `ext`+`simp`.
findings.issue: `SumRuleAssumptions.chargeConj` rebuilds all three fields (`momentum`, `valenceTarget`, `valence`) in exactly the shape of the general `SumRuleAssumptions.relabel` (Basic.lean:196-200) instead of instantiating it; `Assumptions.chargeConj` (Species.lean:203-205) likewise re-splits through `assumptions_iff` rather than using `Assumptions.relabel` (Basic.lean:190-192). These are the only two chargeConj results not derived — `IsPartonDensity/Regularity/sum_mellinMoment` all correctly `exact h.relabel conj`.

summary: The relabel layer is at the right level and most charge-conjugation results are correctly derived from it, but two of them re-prove the general result for the special case, and `valenceNumber_eq_zero_of_eq` assumes a scale-uniform function equality where only equality at the stated `Q2` is used.
